Scores the squad 0-100 against the best possible squad over the next 5 gameweeks and lists the biggest fixes, naming the players; pass t

tools.name: get_my_team
tools.description: Use this for start, bench and captain questions about an FPL manager's own squad: each player's FPL Copilot expected points for the next gameweek with fixtures, and the best XI and captain. It shows the squad and does not score it. Needs their team ID or FPL link, or player names from a screenshot.

tools.name: get_captain_picks
tools.description: Use this when someone asks who to captain (or Triple Captain) in Fantasy Premier League (fantasy football) this gameweek. Call it even without their team: it then lists the best captain options in the game. With a team ID (or their team from an earlier chat) it ranks their own players; scope "all" r

tools.name: find_players
tools.description: Use this to find the best Fantasy Premier League (fantasy football) players to pick or buy, by FPL Copilot expected points (xPts, also called predicted or projected points), filtered by position, price, club or ownership, and sorted by points, value per £m, or as low-owned differentials. Classic FPL

tools.name: get_player
tools.description: Use this for one to five FPL players, e.g. whether to buy, sell or start them: expected points for each coming gameweek with fixtures, injury news, price and price-change progress, ownership, xG/xA and his chance of being the main penalty taker.

tools.name: compare_players
tools.description: Use this when choosing between two or three FPL players (e.g. 'Saka or Palmer?', one transfer for another, or whether a -4 hit is worth it): expected points over the coming gameweeks, form, price and ownership side by side.

tools.name: get_fixture_ticker
tools.description: Use this for Fantasy Premier League fixture difficulty (FDR) and which teams have the easiest or hardest fixtures: each club's coming fixtures and their average difficulty, easiest runs first.

tools.name: get_price_changes
tools.description: Use this for FPL price rises and falls: players likely to change price tonight, or changes already made this gameweek.

tools.name: get_penalty_takers
tools.description: Use this to find who takes penalties, corners and free kicks for Premier League clubs in FPL, with each penalty taker's chance of being his club's main taker.

tools.name: get_best_chip_squad
tools.description: Use this when someone wants the best FPL Wildcard or Free Hit squad for any gameweek, or the best FPL team right now, built by FPL Copilot's optimiser within £100m and FPL squad rules. Not for a Bench Boost team or when to play a chip: the result links FPL Copilot's Chip Strategies for that.

tools.name: get_mini_league
tools.description: Use this for an FPL mini-league or a manager's rivals in it: standings, the gap to the leader, and rivals' captains and differential picks. Without a league ID it lists the manager's leagues to choose from.

tools.name: get_mini_league_odds
tools.description: Use this when an FPL manager asks their chances (or odds) of winning their mini-league: each manager's win and top-3 probability from 5,000 simulations of the rest of the season.

tools.name: get_gameweek_review
tools.description: Use this to review an FPL manager's gameweek: points vs the average, captain result, bench points and transfers, plus how lucky their season has been against FPL Copilot's expected points.

tools.name: get_deadline
tools.description: Use this for the next Fantasy Premier League deadline time and gameweek.

tools.name: get_predicted_lineups
tools.description: Use this for predicted Premier League starting XIs and team news for the next FPL gameweek (who starts, who is injured or rotated), from FPL Copilot's expected minutes.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Use this for Fantasy Premier League rules and how-to questions (scoring, free transfers, chips and when to play them, DefCon, FDR) and FPL Copilot's guides: gameweek tips, chip guides, penalty takers, fixtures. tools.name: read_guide
tools.description: Use this to read one FPL Copilot Fantasy Premier League guide in full, by its slug or its fplcopilot.com/blog/ link.

tools.name: create_share_link
tools.description: Creates a public fplcopilot.com page for an FPL Copilot card so it can be shared.

tools.name: get_player_breakdown
tools.description: The FPL Copilot player card's data for one player (for the card's own view).

tools.name: get_player_breakdowns
tools.description: The FPL Copilot player cards' data for the players on a card (for the card's own view).

tools.name: get_manager_squad
tools.description: An FPL mini-league rival's squad for the league card's own view.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_captain_picks, get_gameweek_review · Public sink: create_share_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_captain_picks, get_gameweek_review · Public sink: create_share_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
